name: Emerald Cove Sea Caves & Kayak Sanctuary
description: Stunning crystalline sea caves with bioluminescent waters and secluded pebble beaches accessible by sea kayak or guided paddleboard tour.
concierge_tips: Best visited at morning high tide between 9:00 AM and 11:30 AM when sunlight illuminates the cave grottos. We can arrange private eco-kayak gear directly delivered from the resort beach club.

name: Historic Old Town Citadel & Artisan Market
description: 17th-century cobblestone fortress town featuring local perfume ateliers, Mediterranean ceramic workshops, boutique galleries, and open-air cafés.
concierge_tips: Visit in the late afternoon before sunset. Stroll down Rue des Oliviers for bespoke handmade fragrances and olive oil tastings.

name: Monte Azure Cliffside Botanical Gardens
description: 15-acre terraced botanical gardens perched over the Mediterranean with over 2,000 exotic subtropical cacti, succulents, and panoramic cliff vistas.
concierge_tips: Wear comfortable walking shoes for the terraced stairs. The garden café serves artisanal iced hibiscus tea.

name: Azure Marina Promenade & Luxury Boutiques
description: Chic waterfront promenade lined with superyachts, luxury designer boutiques, gelato artisans, and lively champagne bars.
concierge_tips: Take the complimentary resort house Mercedes shuttle or enjoy a scenic 15-minute coastal stroll along the Cliff Walkway.
